title: a build may require any well-formed field name, with or without a fields entry; a malformed name is reported
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, the v0.1.0 cut (a required field needs only a well-formed name)
intent: With no fields key, requires [color] validates. requires [Color] is not a field name.

files.jitso/jitso.yaml:
# JITSO allowlists (ADR-0027). A build, and any override a launch asks for,
# may name only what is listed here. `cli/jitso/catalog.test.ts` asserts that every
# entry exists in this repo: skills under `.agents/skills/`, MCP servers in
# `.mcp.json`, Sonnet/Opus ids in `.agents/project.yaml` (`orchestration:`).
# Models are full ids, never aliases.
version: 1

models:
  - claude-haiku-5-5
  - claude-sonnet-5-5
  - claude-opus-5-5

efforts: [low, medium, high]

mcp: [dbhub, openapi]

skills:
  - sprint-testing
  - shift-left-testing
  - test-automation
  - framework-development
  - exploratory-testing
  - orca-orchestration

tools: [Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit]
